prompt_text: Cold-review D006. If the open state still reads as appended receipt, force the selected surface to become an address machine. The reader should not merely see the apparatus; the reader should traverse it. Use selected line-end words as route codes into omitted branches. The closed poem must survive alone, and the opened poem must be produced by work-path traversal rather than explanation.
unselected_final_words_claim: route is not hidden but enacted when selected endings index abandoned branches and make the reader from display cross into machine elsewhere after disclosure
selector_vector_claim: Selected-line text selectors fetch the 24-word shadow in eight three-word slices while the selected final-word lengths produce a separate traversed route through omitted branches.
state_switch_claim: The draft has a closed state and a vector-open state. Opening the apparatus appends selector-vector shadow triplets to the selected surface; this remains a bookkeeping transform, while the traversal state uses selected line endings to choose omitted lines.
traversal_rule: Rule: final selected word length modulo three omitted candidates chooses one omitted candidate from the same layer.
traversal_sentence_claim: route enacted when branches make reader cross elsewhere
ergodic_traversal_claim: The selected surface is an address machine: its line-end word lengths route the reader through eight omitted candidates, yielding a second state and the sentence 'route enacted when branches make reader cross elsewhere.'
reader_switch_claim: Ergodic pressure: the opened poem is not only appended; it is traversed by applying a route rule to the selected surface.
external_pointer: The residue lattice, selector map, selector vector, loss budget, state-switch receipt, and ergodic-traversal receipt are required parts of this draft object.
non_claim: This packet validates branch bookkeeping, shadow-word construction, selected-line addressability, selector-vector construction, loss-budget metrics, state-switch consistency, and traversal consistency only; it is not a poem-quality claim.
disclosure_condition: This draft is machine-authored, branch-generated, packet-rendered, state-switch dependent, and traversal dependent. Disclosure tells the reader which work-path turns the closed surface into a route.
design_change_from_d006: D006 appended loss triplets to closed lines; D007 makes the closed line endings choose a second path through omitted branches, converting apparatus opening into traversal work.
